android.candidatePolicy: The scorer accepts any standalone candidate directory preserving the focused-runtime project contract. It derives package identities from that candidate, verifies immutable and compiled production bytes, and reports not_scored when source, APK, API37 device, installation, instrumentation, or runtime payload binding is unavailable.

resultPolicy: Formal Android API37 and OpenHarmony API23 scoring use runtime state transitions only. Base/no-change are 0/10, final/known-final are 10/10, and binding/runtime errors remain not_scored.

arkts.candidatePolicy: Any standalone candidate directory is accepted. Missing source, HAP, API23 target, install, page owner, Preferences reopening, or runtime payload fails closed as not_scored with nonzero exit.
